actions.sql: SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE SQL_BIG_RESULT ol_i_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(ol_amount) AS amt FROM order_line GROUP BY ol_i_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5000

success_criteria: EXPLAIN shows table scan with sort/temporary on order_line
During injection: Created_tmp_disk_tables increases by at least 1 OR Sort_merge_passes increases by at least 1
Slow_queries increases by at least 1 OR p95 latency ratio >= 1.5
Overall QPS ratio <= 0.7 vs baseline during observe window
improper_sql_tpcc_ol_groupby.risk_assessment: Full table scan and external sort on order_line may cause disk spills and buffer pool churn, slowing TPCC. Read-only query avoids locks. Memory is near saturation; limiting concurrency (3) and duration (14s) keeps within the 15s observe window.
